title: DSA Output Practice & Memory Diagnostics Lab
subtitle: Test your mental model of pointer arithmetic, stack frames, linked lists, and struct alignment in C

questions.title: Recursive Stack Frame Unwinding
questions.explanation: Recursion prints `n` during stack pushing (5, 3, 1), base case hits `n <= 0`, then unwinds stack printing `n` again (1, 3, 5).

questions.title: Singly Linked List Traversal Output
questions.explanation: Traversing through `next` pointers prints values 100, 200, 300 sequentially until `p == NULL`.

questions.title: Circular Queue Rear Modulo Arithmetic
questions.explanation: `rear` increments from 3 -> 4, then `(4 + 1) % 5` wraps around to 0, then 1, then 2.

questions.title: Struct Memory Alignment Padding
questions.explanation: On 32/64-bit systems, `char a` has 3 padding bytes to align `int b` on a 4-byte boundary, and `char c` has 3 padding bytes, giving 1 + 3 + 4 + 1 + 3 = 12 bytes total.
